failedSmoke.symptom: worker-start returned state ready/input_accepted, but the OpenCode session was never created; the TUI showed the high model plus a startup integration/MCP blocker, and the task prompt was never submitted.

credentialPropagation.conclusion: The wrapper inherits the same HOME/XDG data and global OpenCode Go credential as the normal worker. There is no managed OpenCode account profile to propagate.

rootCause.explanation: tui-idle can be satisfied before the OpenCode provider/MCP startup settles. A startup modal swallowed Enter, so the prompt stayed in the composer and no session was created.

fix.privateConfig: The wrapper generates OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT from the real global config: build agent at opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash#high, with every MCP server disabled for this private process only. No headers, environment, or secrets are copied.
fix.readinessGate: After tui-idle the launcher waits 4s, reads the rendered TUI screen, and refuses to send the task if Connect an integration, MCP server failed, or a non-ready composer is visible.
fix.verificationGate: The launcher does not call a worker started on input acceptance alone: pending assistant-message proof yields awaiting_verification, mismatch yields failed, high yields started.
